seo.homeTitle: Nodra · Go 데스크톱 앱을 위한 반응형 상태 관리
seo.homeDescription: Nodra는 Go 데스크톱 앱을 위한 동시성 안전 반응형 상태 스토어입니다. 버전 Store, 선택자 구독, 실행 취소/다시 실행, 영속화와 비동기 작업을 제공합니다.

home.sub: 동시성 안전 버전 Store[T]입니다. 쓰기는 잠금을 기다리고, 커밋마다 버전이 증가하며, 값이 바뀐 구독자에게만 알리고, 실패하면 롤백합니다.
home.howTitle: 상황이 복잡해질 때 Store는 어떻게 동작할까요?
home.ftTag: A concurrency-safe reactive state store for Go desktop apps. A versioned Store, independent from renderer and persistence.
home.s1p: Every commit gets a new version. Listeners run synchronously on the writer goroutine after the lock is released — failed callbacks and panics never publish a partial value.
home.s2p: Track adds undo/redo to any Store: nested groups across frames, field-level filtering, payload budgets, and evicted entries that release their references.
home.s3p: Codecs encode, Storage owns bytes. Stack migrations, AES-GCM encryption, journal recovery and cross-process conflict detection as you need them.
home.s4p: Debounced, cancelable, queued async actions. Newer runs are never overwritten by obsolete ones; retries require explicit idempotency, and Scope shuts down in order.
home.s5p: Selectors filter native frame requests while MyGo keeps rendering. A local DevTools inspector ships read-only and authenticated.
